hooks.command:
FILE=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['tool_input'].get('file_path',''))"); [ -z "$FILE" ] && exit 0; python3 -c "
import sys, re
f_path = sys.argv[1]
if not (('/src/pages/' in f_path or '/src/components/' in f_path or 'timeaAgentKnowledge' in f_path) and (f_path.endswith('.vue') or f_path.endswith('.ts'))):
    sys.exit(0)
content = open(f_path, errors='replace').read()
if '\u2014' in content:
    print('Em dash detected in ' + f_path)
    sys.exit(2)
if re.search(r' -- ', content):
    print('Fake em dash ( -- ) detected in ' + f_path)
    sys.exit(2)
" "$FILE"
